verdicts_file.verite: no_bound: VERITE carries no date, so the as-of rule gives it no evidence

rules.doc_ids: supported/refuted: the documents the verdict rests on; not enough evidence: every document shown
rules.earliest_bound: a claim with several bounds takes its earliest unit
rules.shared_with_verite: a claim text in both M4FC and VERITE keeps VERITE's no_bound row (VERITE has no date); its M4FC record abstains
